property_summary: For any callee address and inputs, the correct contract C always performs external (non-static) calls so that stateful callee behavior (e.g., changing its own state or returning non-empty) can succeed; replacing call with staticcall prevents stateful external effects and can change observable outcomes — in particular, calling into a callee that requires non-static invocation will succeed with C but fail (revert or return empty) with the mutant.
change_summary: Replace the call with a staticcall, making external calls read-only and likely changing observable effects on the external contract invoked.
